headline: Rules on 120 Installments and Servicer Framework: What Kyriakos Pierrakakis Said
summary: Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis said the new 120-installment arrangement does not cover 2025 debts, citing the tax office's existing 24-installment scheme.
why: Installment schemes determine how quickly businesses and households repay tax arrears, which affects public revenue collection and borrowers' cash flow.
